title: Cron roster semantic guard

portable_to: Hermes Agent cron in no-agent mode
another scheduler that can inspect the Hermes job store

inputs: scheduler metadata with private values removed

risk.confirmation: may update local monitor state and send transition alerts only

secrets_policy: monitor tokens and delivery destinations remain local
limitations: This watches one specific job roster; copied names, schedules, and required jobs need to be replaced.
Scheduler status ok is not proof that a job produced a correct business result.
Transition-only delivery can hide a dead monitor unless a separate heartbeat watches the watcher.

requires: access to scheduler metadata and receipts
